steps.caption: Settings
steps.narration: Choose how clients may pay you online: by bank transfer, by card, or both.

steps.caption: Payment methods you offer
steps.narration: In Settings, under Payments, find Payment methods you offer.

steps.caption: Allowed methods
steps.narration: Open Allowed methods. You can allow both, bank transfer only, or card only.

steps.caption: Bank only above an amount
steps.narration: With both allowed, you can make large payments bank transfer only. Type the amount where that starts.

steps.caption: Save payment methods
steps.narration: Choose Save payment methods. Clients only see the methods you allow.

steps.selector: [data-testid="section-card-fee"] >> text=Pass the card processing fee to the client
steps.caption: The card fee
steps.narration: Next, you can pass the card processing fee to the client.

steps.caption: Switch it on
steps.narration: Switch it on, and a card checkout adds a line called Card processing fee.

steps.caption: Card surcharge
steps.narration: Type the percent to add for cards.

steps.caption: Bank transfer has no added fee
steps.narration: A client who pays by bank transfer is never charged that fee.

steps.caption: Open payments
steps.narration: These rules apply to online payments through your own Stripe account, set up on the Payments page.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Payment methods are in Settings, near the bottom of the left menu.

youtube.title: How to choose the payment methods clients can use | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Decide how clients pay you online in the ConstructHUB CRM: bank transfer, card, or both, with bank transfer only above an amount you set. You can also pass the card processing fee to the client. Recorded in a demo workspace with a stand-in payment account.
